summary: Vox Royalty filed a 6-K attaching a press release announcing an amended and restated revolving credit facility upsized to $100 million with a $50 million accordion, for total potential capacity of $150 million, replacing the prior $40 million facility. BMO Capital Markets and National Bank Capital Markets acted as Co-Lead Arrangers, BMO as Sole Bookrunner and Administrative Agent. Pricing is SOFR plus 2.25%-3.25% with a 0.506%-0.731% standby fee; maturity October 1, 2029, with one-year extension options. The facility is undrawn and also notes two senior hires.
